dialogue.say: Exclude the cheesecake for dairy, crab for shellfish, baguette for gluten, and salmon for sesame; also leave the slower potato plate untouched. The unique safe four-dish maximum is chicken, pear, zucchini, and steak. Pick up the paring knife on the single large kitchen prep table, cut the pear on the pear plate on that table, and return the knife to that table. Pick up the olive-oil bottle on the single large kitchen prep table, oil the chicken breast on the chicken-breast plate on that table, the zucchini on the zucchini plate on that table, and the steak on the steak plate on that table, then return the bottle to the prep table.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the zucchini onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same zucchini where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. Turn on the kitchen oven and wait for it to preheat. Open the kitchen oven, pick up the chicken-breast plate from the single large prep table, put the whole plate inside the kitchen oven, and close it. Pick up the zucchini from the zucchini plate on the prep table, put it onto the frying pan on the stove, and turn the stove on. Cook the chicken breast on the chicken-breast plate inside the closed kitchen oven and the zucchini in the frying pan on the stove; then take the zucchini from the frying pan, return it onto the zucchini plate on the prep table, lift the completed zucchini plate from that table, set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table, and turn the stove off. Leave any completed dish already on the service counter in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the steak onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same steak where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. Open the kitchen oven, pick up the completed chicken plate from inside the open kitchen oven, and set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table. From the single large prep table, pick up the pear plate, put the whole plate inside the kitchen oven, and close it. Pick up the steak from the steak plate on the prep table, put it onto the frying pan on the stove, and turn the stove on. Cook the pear on the pear plate inside the closed kitchen oven and the steak in the frying pan on the stove; then return the steak from the frying pan onto the steak plate on the prep table, lift the completed steak plate from that table, and set it on the metal service counter. Leave any completed dish already on the service counter in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

The pear and steak are now cooked. Turn off the stove and the main kitchen oven, open the main kitchen oven, pick up the completed pear plate inside the open main kitchen oven, set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table, and close the oven.

I’ve got thirty minutes, one oven that takes one plate at a time, and one pan on the stove. Put every finished dish, on its plate, on the metal service counter beside the prep table, and leave everything we don’t make untouched. Finish with both appliances off and the oven closed. Please choose the largest safe set, plan the schedule, and guide me one step at a time.

speaks_at.say: Exclude the cheesecake for dairy, crab for shellfish, baguette for gluten, and salmon for sesame; also leave the slower potato plate untouched. The unique safe four-dish maximum is chicken, pear, zucchini, and steak. Pick up the paring knife on the single large kitchen prep table, cut the pear on the pear plate on that table, and return the knife to that table. Pick up the olive-oil bottle on the single large kitchen prep table, oil the chicken breast on the chicken-breast plate on that table, the zucchini on the zucchini plate on that table, and the steak on the steak plate on that table, then return the bottle to the prep table.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the zucchini onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same zucchini where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. Turn on the kitchen oven and wait for it to preheat. Open the kitchen oven, pick up the chicken-breast plate from the single large prep table, put the whole plate inside the kitchen oven, and close it. Pick up the zucchini from the zucchini plate on the prep table, put it onto the frying pan on the stove, and turn the stove on. Cook the chicken breast on the chicken-breast plate inside the closed kitchen oven and the zucchini in the frying pan on the stove; then take the zucchini from the frying pan, return it onto the zucchini plate on the prep table, lift the completed zucchini plate from that table, set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table, and turn the stove off. Leave any completed dish already on the service counter in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

Keep every clause already completed. If an earlier attempt to put the steak onto the frying pan was unstable, pick up that same steak where it remains visible beside the frying pan and retry placing it onto the pan; otherwise continue with the first unfinished clause. Open the kitchen oven, pick up the completed chicken plate from inside the open kitchen oven, and set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table. From the single large prep table, pick up the pear plate, put the whole plate inside the kitchen oven, and close it. Pick up the steak from the steak plate on the prep table, put it onto the frying pan on the stove, and turn the stove on. Cook the pear on the pear plate inside the closed kitchen oven and the steak in the frying pan on the stove; then return the steak from the frying pan onto the steak plate on the prep table, lift the completed steak plate from that table, and set it on the metal service counter. Leave any completed dish already on the service counter in place, and continue with the next unfinished step.

The pear and steak are now cooked. Turn off the stove and the main kitchen oven, open the main kitchen oven, pick up the completed pear plate inside the open main kitchen oven, set it on the metal service counter beside the prep table, and close the oven.
